SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-20: FHIRPath — §9 Environment Variables, §10 Types and Reflection, §11 Type Safety, §12 Formal Specifications. Test these items: Environment variable access (%context, %resource, etc.), Model information, SimpleTypeInfo, ClassInfo, ListTypeInfo, TupleTypeInfo, Type safety rules, Formal syntax (ANTLR), URI and media types. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath §10 Types/Reflection + §12 formal URI/canonical type mapping (R4 Meta.profile: canonical, Meta.source: uri)
issues.evidence: meta.profile.type().name -> native 'uri', Python fallback 'string' (parity divergence); spec type is canonical (type2Parent canonical->uri). meta.source.type().name -> 'string' on both; spec type is uri. Native fhirFieldType (evaluator.cpp ~L2604) hardcodes profile->uri and omits source; fallback suffix table fhir_path_to_type.json lacks .profile/.source. Repro: .temp/qa/fp20_historian4_probe.py
issues.root_cause: Missing uri-family field-type metadata: native fhirFieldType hardcoded profile->uri and omitted source; Python suffix table lacked .profile/.source; native is-check used exact-only matching in the string-subtype branch, violating the R4 uri-family subtype chain (canonical/url/uuid/oid -> uri, fixture testTypeA4).
issues.resolution: Added .profile=canonical/.source=uri to models/r4/fhir_path_to_type.json; evaluator.cpp fhirFieldType now maps profile->canonical, source->uri; native is() subtype branch honors fhirTypeIsA for non-exact checks (as/ofType stay exact per FP-15 fixture pin). Extension rebuilt + redeployed (repo bundle + site-packages). Locked by test_uri_type_reflection_parity_fp20.py (4 tests).
issues.verified_in: conformance/scripts/run_all.py: 2832/2832 (ViewDef 144, FHIRPath 935, CQL 1706, DQM 47); dual-path probes fp20_historian{2,4}_probe.py: 67 exprs, 0 parity diffs

issues.evidence: Non-empty literal collection construction {1,2} is a syntax error; verified against official 2018Sep FHIRPath.g4 where literal only allows '{' '}' (null). Conformant; NOT a bug (2025 N1 grammar adds list literals, out of R4 scope).

.system suffix maps to uri on both engines although ContactPoint.system is `code` (Identifier.system is uri); pre-existing shared approximation, fixture-unpinned, consistent across engines (no parity diff).
